Xbox Hub private-source build validation trigger
Request: validate stable manifest endpoint preconfiguration and current secure ciphertext handoff pipeline
Source version: 0.1.7-preview.1
Source commit: 884384fe188aa0128f7e8510696f7e6008325721
Scope: Windows x64 restore, app/updater publish, exact two-file ZIP validation, versioned runner-local package, offline manifest signer positive/negative tests, AES-256-GCM/RSA-OAEP encrypted package handoff with disposable CI recipient keys, authenticated tamper rejection, optional production ciphertext upload (must remain skipped until owner public key is configured), and updater transaction tests.
Security: production release-signing and package-decryption private keys/passphrases remain on the owner's trusted PC. CI uses disposable keys only. No plaintext package, private source archive, private key, TLS key, Cloudflare token, or credential is uploaded.
